🚀 Hiring: Apriso Developer – DXC / Lockheed Martin
📍 Location: 100% Remote (Anywhere in the U.S. except California)
📅 Duration: 6-Month Contract (High likelihood of extension or conversion)
Work Authorization: U.S. Citizens Only

Job Description:
We are looking for an experienced Apriso Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Apriso Process Builder and a solid background in manufacturing. The ideal candidate will have experience supporting post-go-live operations, understanding manufacturing processes, and customizing Apriso MES solutions.

🔹 Key Responsibilities  Required Skills:
Hands-on experience with Apriso Process Builder.Strong focus on post-go-live support and production issue resolution
.Experience with the Apriso Order Maintenance module is a plus.
Strong manufacturing domain expertise, including manufacturing processes and production workflows.
Understanding of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) and industry best practices.
Proficiency in C#, .NET, JavaScript, and Apriso customization frameworks.
Ability to troubleshoot issues and support manufacturing operations in a production environment.
🔹 Required Background:
Must have relevant experience in the manufacturing domain.
Candidates with experience in finance, municipal, or unrelated industries will not be considered.
Must be a U.S. Citizen.Must reside outside California, as this position is not open to California-based candidates.

📩 Interested candidates: Please share your updated resume at ashish.kumar@sourceinfotech.com

#Hiring #AprisoDeveloper #Apriso #MES #Manufacturing #CSharp #DotNet #JavaScript #DXC #LockheedMartin #RemoteJobs #ITJobs
comment: In MES, a fix that resolves the immediate issue can still disrupt downstream production workflows. Knowing the root cause and validating the impact across connected processes is what separates solid support from firefighting.
